text:
maria_obs: quick pulse — where are we on the console observability pieces for the next milestone? specifically: dashboard landing page for errors, tracing hook UX, and retention gating for traces + logs?
kevin_runtime: dashboard landing page — basic widgets wired, need prod metrics IAM to flip on. blocked on #infra-perms. planning to send PR for UI tweaks today.
samir_ml: tracing hooks — SDK change landed, integration tests failing in canary (kv cache header). digging now. likely a 1-day delay. @kevin_runtime heads up: new header means slight route change.
jen_prod: retention gating — legal wants 3/7/30 day tiers documented for privacy review. I can own docs and policy but need engineering ETA for implementation (api + console).
maria_obs: owners: @kevin_runtime for dashboards, @samir_ml for tracing hooks, @jen_prod for retention policy/docs. confirm? :point_down:
kevin_runtime: confirm for dashboards. will own rollout plan and canary. ETA for IAM fix: EOD tomorrow.
samir_ml: confirm for tracing hooks. ETA for test fix + canary re-run: tomorrow afternoon. will post failing jobs in the thread.
jen_prod: confirm for docs/policy. Will draft policy and share with legal by Wednesday.
maria_obs: dependencies: 1) infra-perms (to show prod metrics) 2) sdk header compatibility (samir) 3) retention api (backend) — can infra-bot confirm progress on #1 and #3?
infra-bot: deploy status: infra-perms change (CL 3421) merged to staging, queued for deploy to prod in the 02:00 UTC window. retention-api (ticket INF-212) currently in review, reviewer assigned (kevin-runtime).
kevin_runtime: I'll take INF-212 review this morning and push feedback. If small, we can merge today.
maria_obs: ok good. blockers: any UX objections to landing page layout? I can do a quick design pass if needed.
kevin_runtime: layout is fine for MVP, maybe reduce the number of charts on mobile. :mobile_phone:
samir_ml: no objections. note: tracing hook adds an extra header for client libs, will need a small note in SDK changelog.
jen_prod: once legal sign-off on retention tiers, we should squash commits for policy into a single doc and attach to the release ticket.
maria_obs: action items recap: - kevin: review INF-212 + IAM fix deploy plan - samir: fix canary tests + post results - jen: policy draft to legal by Wed - infra-bot: confirm prod deploy windows (done)
maria_obs: I'll run async follow-up on Friday to close owners and mark milestone readiness. ping here if anything slips. :thumbsup:
